# anomaly_user (Data Source)

Looks up a single nxs-anomaly user by ID or username.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an existing object. Alternatively, supply id instead of username.
data "anomaly_user" "example" {
  username = "alice.smith"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Object ID to look up. Supply either id or the name/username lookup attribute.
- `username` (String)

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `email` (String)
- `locale` (String) UI language for this person. Empty means the UI follows their browser.
- `name` (String)
- `notification_policies` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--notification_policies))
- `notification_targets` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--notification_targets))
- `on_duty` (Boolean)
- `phone` (String)
- `priority` (String)
- `provisioned_by` (String) Name of the infrastructure-as-code tool that owns this object, absent when a person created it.
- `role` (String)
- `telegram_id` (String)
- `timezone` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
